features.statement: Page uses a concise document title in 'brand – full name' form rather than a long welcome sentence.
The main welcome message is marked up as the page's h1 heading.
Uses HTML5 landmark elements (header, nav, main, aside) and more section elements instead of generic article blocks.
Includes ARIA attributes and real button elements for interactive controls such as a menu toggle.
Typography uses only the system-ui font stack, with no web fonts or icon fonts.
Body text is 16px with a roomy 1.6 line height; headings are bold at 700.
Headings use sentence or title case in bold, consistently, rather than small uppercase sidebar labels.
A call-to-action link is shown as a filled green rounded button, separate from the ordinary nav links.
Top bar is dark green and shows social networks as plain text links rather than icon glyphs.
Header pairs a text wordmark and full organisation name with the logo, on a white background.
Hero is live HTML text on a green gradient, with a large white h1 and intro paragraphs.
Hero has two side-by-side CTA buttons: one solid white and one outlined.
Body content is arranged in card columns with a sidebar on the right.
Content sits in white, bordered, rounded cards on an off-white page background.
Layout is built with flexbox and CSS grid.
Newsletter signup is a real form with an email input and a filled green submit button.
Calendar is a plain captioned table with text Previous/Next navigation links and muted gray weekend dates.
Links are deep green text with no chevron markers, used consistently across white cards.
Color palette is green-tinted dark text with a deep green accent and muted green-gray secondary text.
Footer is a single dark-green band, with link groups placed in light cards above it.
Small circular social icons sit on the left next to their label.
Page is minimal and flat, with no shadows, transitions or animations; the only decoration is one hero gradient.
Markup is lean: few anchors, one script, no external stylesheets, almost no inline styles.
Copy is plain and concise, with fewer words and no exclamation marks or emoji.
Small images are scaled down in cards and can be distorted in aspect ratio.
Media embeds such as video players are replaced with text-link cards.
